title: Fill fields from scanned text
description: Map the text layer of a scanned document — pasted in, or copied out of any OCR app — onto W-9 / SA100 style fields. Labelled lines such as "Name: …" are matched deterministically and shown with the line they came from, so a wrong guess is visible. No OCR model ships with this tool, and nothing is invented from pixels.
x-privacyfold-engine: none (plain JavaScript in the browser tab)

input.description: Text to process. Sent to the tool only through the URL fragment / local input.
